# RRS + DEMOGRAPHICS

## Analysis
Demographic, stress/adversity, and medication predictors were harmonized and grouped into three hypothesis families. For each predictor, a univariate linear model was fit with RRS as the outcome, returning raw β estimates and two-sided P-values. Continuous variables were additionally standardized to obtain standardized β and confidence intervals. BH FDR was applied within each predictor family.
```{r}
full_meta <- read.csv("Data/Analysis Data/Metadata/Metadata Complete 2626.csv")

full_meta_plot <- full_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, WK2_Stress_MAX, WK8_Stress_MAX, M3_Stress_MAX, 
                WK2_PROM_Pain4a_T, WK8_PROM_Pain4a_T, M3_PROM_Pain4a_T, 
                WK8_PSS10_Total_RS, M3_PSS10_Total_RS, M6_PSS10_Total_RS,
                PRE_PSS10_CantCope_RS, WK8_PSS10_CantCope_RS, M3_PSS10_CantCope_RS, M6_PSS10_CantCope_RS,
                PRE_PSS10_Distress_RS, WK8_PSS10_Distress_RS, M3_PSS10_Distress_RS, M6_PSS10_Distress_RS,
                WK2_Pain, WK8_Pain, M3_Pain, M6_Pain) %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(meta_RRS_df, by = "PID")

metadata_demo <- meta_RRS_df %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c("Male","Female")),  
    Race   = factor(Race, levels = c("White","Black","Other")),
    Education = factor(Education, levels = c("College graduate", "Less than college", 
                                             "High school graduate","Less than high school")),
    PRE_NSAIDs = factor(PRE_NSAIDs, levels = c("No","Yes")),
    ED_NSAIDs = factor(ED_NSAIDs, levels = c("No","Yes")),
    EDhm_NSAIDs = factor(EDhm_NSAIDs, levels = c("No","Yes")),
    PRE_Opioids = factor(PRE_Opioids, levels = c("No","Yes")),
    ED_Opioids  = factor(ED_Opioids, levels = c("No","Yes")),
    EDhm_Opioids = factor(EDhm_Opioids, levels = c("No","Yes")),
    PRE_SNRIs_SSRIs = factor(PRE_SNRIs_SSRIs, levels = c("No","Yes")),
    PRE_Contcp = factor(PRE_Contcp, levels = c("No","Yes")))


# demographics variables
vars_demographics <- c("Age", "Gender", "Race", "BMI", "ED_Pain","PDI", "ADI")

# "WK2_BFI_Neuro_MN", "WK2_TIPI_Extraversion_MN", "WK2_TIPI_Agreeable_MN", "WK2_TIPI_Conscientious_MN", "WK2_TIPI_OpenExper_MN"

# stress/adversity 
vars_stress <- c("PRE_SF12_PCS","CTQSF","LifeTimeEvent_count","PRE_SF12_MCS","PRE_PSS10_Total_RS","PRE_PROM_Pain4a_T","PRE_PROM_Dep8b_T","PRE_PROM_AnxBank_RS","WK2_PROM_SelfEffEmo4a_T","WK2_CDRISC10_RS", "WK2_PROM_EmoSup4a_RS", "WK2_TIPI_EmoStability_MN")

# medication use 
vars_medications <- c("PRE_NSAIDs", "ED_NSAIDs", "PRE_SNRIs_SSRIs", "PRE_Contcp", "PRE_Opioids", "ED_Opioids")

all_variables <- list(Demographics = vars_demographics, Stress = vars_stress, Medications  = vars_medications)

# run regression for each variable in the respective list 
run_regression <- function(var, data) {
  df <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(RRS, !!sym(var)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))

  # determine variable type
  is_cat <- is.factor(df[[var]]) || is.character(df[[var]])
  if (is_cat) df[[var]] <- factor(df[[var]])

  # raw model
  m <- lm(RRS ~ ., data = df)
  sm <- summary(m)
  coefs <- as.data.frame(sm$coefficients)
  coefs$Term <- rownames(coefs)

  # standardized model (only if continuous)
  if (!is_cat && sd(df[[var]]) > 0) {
    df$y_std <- scale(df$RRS)
    df$x_std <- scale(df[[var]])
    sm_std <- summary(lm(y_std ~ x_std, data = df))
    std_beta <- sm_std$coefficients["x_std", "Estimate"]
    std_se   <- sm_std$coefficients["x_std", "Std. Error"]
  } else {
    std_beta <- std_se <- NA_real_
  }

  # assemble tidy results
  coefs %>%
    filter(Term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = var,
      Sample_Size = nrow(df),
      R_squared = sm$r.squared,
      Std_Coefficient = std_beta,
      Std_SE = std_se,
      CI_lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
      CI_upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
      Std_CI_lower = Std_Coefficient - 1.96 * Std_SE,
      Std_CI_upper = Std_Coefficient + 1.96 * Std_SE,
      Type = ifelse(is_cat, "Categorical", "Continuous")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Coefficient = Estimate,
      Std_Error = `Std. Error`,
      T_value = `t value`,
      P_value = `Pr(>|t|)`)
}

# loop through each list 
regression_results_df <- imap_dfr(all_variables, function(vars, var_class) {
  message("Running domain: ", var_class)
  results <- map_dfr(vars, run_regression, data = metadata_demo)
  results$var_class <- var_class
  results
})

regression_results_df <- regression_results_df %>%
  group_by(var_class) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(P_value, method = "fdr"),
    Significance = if_else(FDR < 0.05, "Significant", "NS")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(FDR)

#write.csv(regression_results_df, "RRS Correlates/Survey Variables Linear Regression Results_Support_20260820.csv")

```

## Results
Univariable linear models of RRS on each demographic, stress/adversity, and medication predictor were summarized into a single results table. Predictors were classified as continuous vs categorical, assigned to Baseline, Stress/Adversity, or Medications families, and FDR-adjusted within family. For visualization, raw β and CIs were retained for categorical predictors, and standardized β and CIs were used for continuous predictors.
```{r}
cat_terms <- c("RaceBlack","RaceOther","GenderFemale",
               "PRE_NSAIDsYes","ED_NSAIDsYes","EDhm_NSAIDsYes","PRE_OpioidsYes",
               "ED_OpioidsYes","PRE_SNRIs_SSRIsYes","PRE_ContcpYes")

baseline_terms <- c("Age","GenderFemale","RaceBlack","RaceOther","BMI", "ED_Pain", "PDI", "ADI")

medication_terms <- c("PRE_NSAIDsYes","ED_NSAIDsYes","PRE_OpioidsYes","ED_OpioidsYes", 
                      "PRE_ContcpYes","PRE_SNRIs_SSRIsYes")

stress_terms <- c("CTQSF","LifeTimeEvent_count","PRE_SF12_MCS","PRE_PCL5_RS",
                  "ED_MCEPS_RS","PRE_PSS10_Total_RS","PRE_PROM_Pain4a_T","PRE_PROM_Dep8b_T",
                  "PRE_PROM_AnxBank_RS","WK2_PROM_SelfEffEmo4a_T","WK2_PROM_EmoSup4a_RS",
                  "WK2_TIPI_EmoStability_MN","WK2_CDRISC10_RS","WK2_FFMQ_RS","M6_FFMQ_RS","PRE_DESB_RS",
                  "WK2_DESB_RS", "PRE_SF12_PCS", "PRE_Pain")

regression_results_df <- regression_results_df %>%
  mutate(
    # categorical vs continuous
    Type = ifelse(Term %in% cat_terms, "Categorical", "Continuous"),
    # conceptual categories
    Category = case_when(
      Term %in% baseline_terms ~ "Physical Health/Demographics",
      Term %in% medication_terms ~ "Medications",
      Term %in% stress_terms ~ "Mental Health/Stress/Adversity",
      TRUE ~ "Other"),

    # FDR significance
    Significance = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant"),

    # unified effect size for plotting
    Plot_Coefficient = ifelse(Type == "Categorical", Coefficient, Std_Coefficient),
    Plot_CI_lower = ifelse(Type == "Categorical", CI_lower,Std_CI_lower),
    Plot_CI_upper = ifelse(Type == "Categorical", CI_upper, Std_CI_upper))
```

## Forest plot 
Effect estimates were visualized using a forest plot stratified by predictor family. Continuous predictors are shown as standardized β, categorical predictors as raw β, each with 95% confidence intervals. Variables are ordered by FDR and effect size within family, and point color encodes whether higher values are associated with higher RRS (Recovered↑), lower RRS (Chronic↓), or non-significant differences.
```{r}

clean_vars <- c(
  Age = "Age",
  ADI = "Area Deprivation Index",
  BMI = "BMI",
  PRE_SF12_PCS= "Overall Physical Health",
  PRE_SF12_MCS = "Overall Mental Health ",
  PRE_Pain = "Pain Prior to TSE",
  ED_Pain = "Pain at ED",

  CTQSF = "Childhood Trauma History",
  PRE_PSS10_Total_RS  = "Perceived Amount of Stress",
  PDI = "Peritraumatic Distress",
  LifeTimeEvent_count = "# of Lifetime TSEs",
  #PRE_PCL5_RS = "PTSD Prior to TSE(↑ = more)",
  PRE_PROM_Pain4a_T = "Pain Interference",
  PRE_PROM_Dep8b_T  = "Depression Severity",
  PRE_PROM_AnxBank_RS  = "Anxiety Severity",

  WK2_CDRISC10_RS = "Psychological Resilience",
  WK2_PROM_SelfEffEmo4a_T = "Emotional Coping Capacity",
  WK2_PROM_EmoSup4a_RS = "Relational Support",
  WK2_TIPI_EmoStability_MN = "Emotional Stability",


  GenderFemale = "Female (vs Male)",
  RaceBlack = "Race: Black (vs White)",
  RaceOther = "Race: Other (vs White)",

  PRE_NSAIDsYes = "NSAIDs Prior to TSE (Yes vs No)",
  ED_NSAIDsYes = "NSAIDs in ED (Yes vs No)",
  #EDhm_NSAIDsYes = "NSAIDs Discharged (Yes vs No)",
  PRE_OpioidsYes = "Opioids Prior to TSE (Yes vs No)",
  ED_OpioidsYes = "Opioids in ED (Yes vs No)",
  PRE_ContcpYes  = "Contraceptive Use Prior to TSE (Yes vs No)",
  PRE_SNRIs_SSRIsYes = "SNRI/SSRI Prior to TSE (Yes vs No)")


vars_present    <- unique(regression_results_df$Term)

# build df for plotting
regression_results_df_plot <- regression_results_df %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      Term %in% baseline_terms ~ "Physical Health/Demographics",
      Term %in% stress_terms ~ "Mental Health/Stress/Adversity",
      Term %in% medication_terms  ~ "Medications",
      TRUE  ~ "Other"),

    # labels
    Display = dplyr::coalesce(
      unname(clean_vars[Term]),
      unname(clean_vars[Variable]),
      Term),

    Sig = factor(ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "sig", "nonsig"),
                 levels = c("nonsig", "sig")),

    # coefficient selection
    Plot_Coefficient = ifelse(Type == "Categorical", Coefficient, Std_Coefficient),

    # CI selection 
    Plot_CI_lower = ifelse(Type == "Categorical", CI_lower, Std_CI_lower),
    Plot_CI_upper = ifelse(Type == "Categorical", CI_upper, Std_CI_upper)) %>%
  
  group_by(Category) %>%
  arrange(FDR,desc(abs(Plot_Coefficient)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Display = factor(Display, levels = rev(unique(Display)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Physical Health/Demographics", "Mental Health/Stress/Adversity", "Medications"), labels = c("Baseline &\n Demographics", "Health & Life History\nPrior to the TSE", "Medication Use")),
    Direction = case_when(
      FDR < 0.05 & Plot_Coefficient > 0 ~ "Recovered ↑",
      FDR < 0.05 & Plot_Coefficient < 0 ~ "Chronic ↓",
      TRUE  ~ "NS"),
    Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Recovered ↑", "Chronic ↓", "NS")))



regression_results_df_export <- regression_results_df_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(Display, P_value, FDR, Coefficient, T_value, Std_Error, 
                R_squared, Std_Coefficient, Std_SE, CI_lower, CI_upper, 
                Std_CI_lower, Std_CI_upper, Type, Category, Sample_Size) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `Variable`= Display,
    `P value` = P_value,
    `FDR` = FDR,
    `Coefficient` = Coefficient,
    `t value` = T_value,
    `Standard error` = Std_Error,
    `R squared` = R_squared,
    `Standardized coefficient` = Std_Coefficient,
    `Standardized SE` = Std_SE,
    `CI lower` = CI_lower,
    `CI upper` = CI_upper,
    `Std CI lower` = Std_CI_lower,
    `Std CI upper` = Std_CI_upper, 
    `Sample Size` = Sample_Size) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x)))

regression_results_df_export <- regression_results_df_export %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor),
    ~ factor(gsub("[↑]", "higher", as.character(.x))))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character),
    ~ gsub("[↑]", "higher", .x))) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

write.csv(regression_results_df_export, "RRS Correlates/Survey Variables Linear Regression Results 20260903.csv")

#range(regression_results_df_plot$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE) 
# -0.84173956  0.01316873

#range(regression_results_df_plot$Std_CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
# -0.3450575  0.1079668

#range(regression_results_df_plot$Std_CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
# -0.09884626  0.35876257


regression_results_df_plot1 <- regression_results_df_plot %>% filter(var_class != "Medications")
# plot 
demographics_forest <- ggplot(
  regression_results_df_plot1,
  aes(x = Plot_Coefficient, y = Display, shape = Type, color = Direction)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Plot_CI_lower, xmax = Plot_CI_upper), height = 0.45,  linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space  = "free", switch = "y") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("nonsig" = 0.7, "sig" = 1), guide  = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Continuous" = 16, "Categorical" = 17)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.9, 0.6), breaks = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Recovered ↑" = "#2698B1",
    "Chronic ↓" = "#2698B1",
    "NS" = "grey30")) +
  labs(x = "Effect size (β)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "none",
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    legend.position = "none")

ggsave(demographics_forest, filename = "Figures/Survey Variables RRS Regression Forest Plot v2.jpg", width = 5.5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
